profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Daugherty Business Solutions
profile.summary:
I am a lifelong learner with a genuine interest in solving challenging problems. With 8 years of experience as a full stack developer, I consistently delivered end-to-end solutions to production environments. My expertise includes Java/Spring and React, enabling me to develop and deploy user experiences that meet high standards of quality and usability.

I also have extensive experience with relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL, as well as data technologies like BigQuery and Elasticsearch. Additionally, I've implemented message-driven solutions using Pub/Sub, enabling efficient and scalable data processing and communication within complex systems.

Throughout my career, I gained extensive experience working with various CI/CD technologies such as GitHub, BitBucket, Concourse, Jenkins, PCF (Pivotal Cloud Foundry), and TeamCity. I am well-versed in leveraging these tools to establish efficient and automated software delivery pipelines. 

In addition to my technical skills, I have spent 6 years working in agile settings, where I have translated business requirements into user stories, coordinated external dependencies, and conducted demos. I am highly skilled in cross-team collaboration, partnering with UX designers and project managers to deliver well-tested solutions that delight end users.

Lastly, mentoring junior engineers in both career matters and technical design and implementation strategies has been a rewarding aspect of my journey. By fostering an environment of continuous learning, I have empowered others to grow and excel in their roles.

positions.title: Software Engineer III / Senior Consultant
positions.description:
• Worked across teams including UX designers to build full fledge customer facing solutions for The Home Depot's Rental Reservations, Quoting and Self Drop-off systems

• Lead a complete re-write of a ReactJS customer-facing large equipment quoting tool which resulted in reusable and testable UI components and maintainable state management solution

• Lead engineer at Home Depot tasked with designing, implementing and deploying a React/Spring Boot customer-facing self-service experience that enables customers to return rental equipment at stores without store employee assistance.

• Implemented message-driven data replication to BigQuery, MySQL, and ElasticSearch for Home Depot rental systems by leveraging GCP Pub Sub & GCP Data Flows

• Implemented several ReactJS components and corresponding Redux reducers & action creators for a Home Depot payments system that enabled card and account lookup capabilities

• Participated in on-call support rotations (Primary and Secondary, PagerDuty)

positions.title: Software Engineer III / Consultant
positions.description:
• Developed customer-facing React user interface components to allow rental customers to create and submit reservations on The Home Depot Rent Online experience.  

• Wrote automated tests and maintained existing test suites using RTL, Jest, JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, and Cucumber BDD. 

• Developed and maintained several backend Spring Boot services to enable Rental features such as creating and modifying reservations, in-store self service, and pricing estimates; Java 11, Spring Boot 2.7+, Maven, Gradle, MySQL, Elasticsearch, GCP Big Query, PubSub
 
• Experience with: A/B Deployments, Feature Switches, Pair Programming, Jira, Confluence, Concourse, GCP, PCF, TeamCity

positions.title: Software Engineer II / Consultant
positions.description:
• Project Lead for 3 Spring Boot applications which exposed RESTful APIs for client applications that provided an Excel Like UI interface

• Successfully refactored and modified entire PostgreSQL database schemas to facilitate future business requirements and updated the NodeJS APIs that read from this database

• Integrated Active Directory sign on solution into their web apps as well as access control capabilities by leveraging Azure Application Roles. 

• Designed and developed complex, data intensive React dashboards.

• Implemented several NodeJS REST APIs 

• Worked in a Jira/Jenkins/Rancher environment. Researched and presented formal proposal to client on how to migrate legacy Excel Macros into modern web apps while maintaining Excel like capabilities on the web.

GPC – NAPA 
	
Software Engineer II
Designed and developed Power BI Reports and provided live demo to leadership. This effort helped the Client understand the benefits of migrating their existing Jasper reports to Power BI.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project Lead, Software Engineer, Mentor

Developed and successfully installed several updates into the production environment for the Lottery division of Scientific Games. Took ownership and was designated Lead of a system wide overhaul of an admin dashboard. Researched, proposed and led the implementation, testing, and release of pattern-oriented solutions involving technologies such as Spring MVC, Spring Security, MDBootstrap 4 UI Framework
